authored-fictional-spies.scope: Named fictional intelligence agents, spies, spymasters and documented clandestine/covert operatives from any medium count, including covert support agents and private fictional agencies. A secret identity, ordinary detective/police work, a group/show title, performer or an unnamed generic agent is not automatically a spy. Actual aliases share identity; different characters, clones and officeholders are not merged merely because they share a codename.
authored-fictional-spies.sourceRoles: Named intelligence/covert operatives; actor, group, series, mascot and ordinary police/detective-only source leads are held. Source occurrence is not independent primary proof.
authored-fictional-spies.identity: Explicit public aliases only; different people, Snakes, codenames and franchises retain their identities.
authored-fictional-spies.numericCodes: Existing pack opt-in preserves full numeric tokens. Fabricated decimal agent codes are not exact answers.
authored-fictional-spies.admission: Only reviewed-standard/admission.json approves normal play. Unfinished scientist/doctor research is not admitted.
authored-fictional-spies.commonNameRepair: Gru is the studio-published AVL-agent name, with secondary full-name alias Felonious Gru. Source typo Felonius is not an exact alias.
